## GSVA

```{r gsva-intro, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$gsva_out)}
cat("\n\nSample-level [GSVA](https://doi.org/10.1186/1471-2105-14-7) on ",
    if (deseq2reports::batch_correction_label(params$gsva_out$expr_correction) != "none") {
      paste0("**", deseq2reports::expr_correction_label(params$gsva_out$expr_correction),
             "** (protecting the grouping variable; DESeq2 still uses raw counts with batch in the design)")
    } else {
      "blind VST expression"
    },
    ". This is **not** ranked-list GSEA: every gene set is scored in ",
    "every sample, independently of clusterProfiler / fgsea (those pages are ",
    "unchanged). Organism: **", params$gsva_out$org, "**.\n\n",
    "**HALLMARK** (~50 sets) is always included and the heatmap shows every ",
    "scored set.\n\n",
    "GO / KEGG / REACTOME / PID have thousands of signatures, so a GSEA-style ",
    "`padj` filter does not help: GSVA assigns a score to every set, and many ",
    "would still pass a cutoff. Instead every set is scored (full CSV) and the ",
    "heatmap keeps the top **", params$gsva_out$n_heatmap,
    "** pathways whose sample scores differ most across `",
    params$gsva_out$var, "` (Kruskal–Wallis; variance if the test is undefined). ",
    "Change the number with `gsva_n_heatmap`.\n\n", sep = "")
deseq2reports::emit_code_block(
  caption = "Reproduce GSVA with this package module:",
  "gsva_out <- run_gsva_pipeline(dds_qc, var = \"condition\")"
)
```

```{r gsva-missing, results='asis', eval=is.null(params$gsva_out)}
cat("\n\nGSVA was not run for this report (`run_gsva = FALSE` or `gsva_out = NULL`).\n\n")
```

```{r gsva-heatmaps, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$gsva_out)}
colls <- params$gsva_out$collections
if (!length(colls)) {
  cat("\n\nNo GSVA collections were scored.\n\n")
} else {
  pane_ids <- deseq2reports::bs_tabset_start("gsva-collections", colls)
  for (i in seq_along(colls)) {
    coll <- colls[i]
    deseq2reports::bs_tab_pane_start(pane_ids[i], active = (i == 1L))
    hm <- params$gsva_out$heatmaps[[coll]]
    st <- params$gsva_out$stats[[coll]]
    cat("<p>", if (identical(coll, "HALLMARK")) {
      "All scored HALLMARK gene sets (row-scaled GSVA scores)."
    } else {
      paste0("All ", if (!is.null(st)) nrow(st) else "?",
             " sets were scored; heatmap shows the top ",
             params$gsva_out$n_heatmap,
             " by Kruskal–Wallis p-value vs <code>",
             params$gsva_out$var, "</code> (table below is the same ranking).")
    }, "</p>\n", sep = "")
    if (!is.null(hm)) {
      deseq2reports::emit_heatmap_with_download(
        hm, filename = paste0("gsva_", coll, "_heatmap"),
        buttons = list(deseq2reports::link_output_file(
          file.path(coll, "gsva_scores.csv"), label = "Download scores CSV"
        ))
      )
    } else {
      cat("<p>No heatmap for this collection.</p>\n")
    }
    if (!is.null(st) && nrow(st)) {
      show <- utils::head(st, 25L)
      btn <- deseq2reports::link_output_file(
        file.path(coll, "gsva_pathway_stats.csv"),
        label = "Download pathway stats CSV"
      )
      deseq2reports::emit_widget_with_download(
        deseq2reports::make_gsea_datatable(show, page_length = 15), btn
      )
    }
    deseq2reports::bs_tab_pane_end()
  }
  deseq2reports::bs_tabset_end()
}
```
